Goodies is the sixth album by jazz guitarist George Benson recorded in 1968 and released on the Verve label.[3]

Reception

[edit]

AllMusic awarded the album 2 stars stating "Verve needed one more album from Benson after he signed with A&M/CTI, and ended up with a strange grab-bag in which Benson plays superbly throughout, whatever the odd goulash of sounds in back of him".[2]
